attacks.claim: Smart Send Time builds a per-subscriber behavioural profile from 90 days of open data and is enabled by default for every publication. The artifact describes no subscriber notice, consent, or reader-side opt-out, so this profiling may be collected without a lawful basis (e.g., GDPR, ePrivacy) for EU or UK subscribers.
attacks.evidence: ABSENT: any subscriber-facing notice, consent mechanism, or reader opt-out. Artifact says: "Inkwell predicts each subscriber's most likely open hour from their last 90 days of opens... Enabled by default for all publications; publishers can turn it off in Settings → Delivery."
